title: Blue Breeze - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Why Guests Love Staying Here:

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties 🏖️ Right on the Gulf! Just a couple of minutes and your feet are in the sand ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🌅 PRIVATE Beach for Guests & Owners (Low Density – Only 24 Units) 🚲 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes Included + Child Carrier Rental Across the Street (Save $50/day) 📍 Centrally Located in Seagrove Beach along 30A — Walk to Restaurants & Shops, 1.3 mi to Seaside 🏝️ Tommy Bahama Chairs, Umbrellas, Cooler & Pool/Beach Towels Provided 💤 Sleeps Up to 6 (King Bed, Hall Bunks & Sofa Bed) ☕ Keurig + Drip Coffee Maker 👶 Pack ’n Play (Bring Your Own Sheets) 🛏️ Upgraded Memory Foam Sofa Bed Mattress + Blackout Curtains Throughout 🏊 Community Pool & Grill 🧺 Washer/Dryer Inside Unit 🍳 Fully Stocked Kitchen 📺 Smart TVs in Living Room & Bedroom ⚡ High-Speed Wi-Fi 🚴‍♀️ Directly on 30A Bike Path (Explore 19 Miles of Scenic Trails)

Relax and unwind in this cozy Seagrove condo. Boasting Gulf views and direct beach access, this one-bedroom getaway comes fully equipped with all the comforts of home. The full kitchen comes ready for home cooking with a full suite of major appliances, including a dishwasher for easy cleanup. The private balcony is perfect for sipping a morning cup of coffee or a sunset cocktail. The spacious primary bedroom includes a 40 inch smart TV for added entertainment options. A built-in hallway bunk nook is great for kids to have their own space.

WHAT'S NEARBY This property is part of the Beachside Condos, a Gulf-front complex in Seagrove with a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. You'll be across the street from several shops, eateries, and recreational outfitters that rent bikes and kayaks.

THINGS TO KNOW

Parking notes: 1 spot per unit. No assigned spot, can park in any spot.

Golf cart rentals are allowed. You can rent a gas powered golf cart and utilize your 1 parking space OR rent a battery powered golf cart rental across the street at Butterfly Bike and Kayak and park/charge there.

This rental is located on floor 2. No elevator onsite.

Sorry, HOA does not allow pets.

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens

Property Type: Condo in a condo on the 2nd floor
Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
